info.title: Dopamine API
info.summary: Dopamine is a social app for connecting people.
info.description:
Dopamine is a social app for connecting people: share posts, follow friends (private accounts approve followers), comment and react, get notified, and chat one-to-one or in groups in real time.

**Auth** — send `Authorization: Bearer <access_token>` from `POST /auth/login`. Tokens are single-session JWTs;
`POST /auth/refresh` rotates both. **Language** — `Accept-Language: ar` returns Arabic messages.
**Responses** — success: `{ message, data?, meta? }`; errors: `{ errorMessage, error? }`.
**Downloads** — [Postman collection](/docs/postman.json) · [OpenAPI JSON](/docs/swagger.json)

## Realtime (Socket.IO)

Connect with `io(BASE_URL, { auth: { token: ACCESS_TOKEN } })` (optionally `auth.language: "ar"`). Each socket joins
`user:<id>`; join `conversation:<id>` rooms with `conversation:join`. Client events take an ack callback that receives
`{ ok: true, data }` or `{ ok: false, error, messageCode }`. Not available on the Vercel deployment (no WebSockets).

| Client → Server | Payload |
| --- | --- |
| `conversation:join` / `conversation:leave` | `{ conversationId }` |
| `message:send` | `{ conversationId, content?, type?, media?, replyTo?, clientId? }` |
| `message:edit` | `{ messageId, content }` |
| `message:delete` | `{ messageId }` |
| `message:read` | `{ conversationId, messageId? }` |
| `typing:start` / `typing:stop` | `{ conversationId }` |
| `notification:read` | `{ notificationId }` |

| Server → Client | Payload |
| --- | --- |
| `message:new` | `Message` (+ `clientId` echoed) |
| `message:delivered` | `{ conversationId, messageId, deliveredTo }` |
| `message:read:update` | `ReadReceipt` |
| `message:edited` / `message:deleted` | `{ conversationId, messageId, content?, editedAt? }` |
| `typing:update` | `{ conversationId, userId, isTyping }` |
| `conversation:updated` | `Conversation` |
| `presence:online` / `presence:offline` / `presence:update` | `{ userId, isOnline, lastSeenAt }` |
| `notification:new` | `{ notification, unreadCount }` |
| `notification:read:update` | `{ notificationId, unreadCount }` or `{ all: true, unreadCount: 0 }` |

tags.name: Auth
tags.description: Register, verify email, sign in (password or Google), refresh and revoke sessions, reset passwords.

tags.name: Users
tags.description: Your profile, other profiles, search and suggestions, followers/following, blocking.

tags.name: Follow requests
tags.description: Following public accounts is instant; private accounts receive a request to accept or reject.

tags.name: Posts
tags.description: Home feed, create/edit/delete posts, likes, saves and shares.

tags.name: Comments
tags.description: Comments and one-level replies on posts, with likes.

tags.name: Notifications
tags.description: Activity about you (follows, likes, comments, shares). Also pushed live as `notification:new`.

tags.name: Conversations
tags.description: Direct and group chats over REST. Sending, editing and deleting messages happens over Socket.IO.

tags.name: Reports
tags.description: Report users, posts or comments. Listing and reviewing are admin-only.

`type: "SINGLE"` (default) revokes this session (+ the given refresh token); `"ALL"` revokes every session.

post.description: Direct: `participantIds: [otherUserId]` (an existing chat is returned instead of a duplicate). Group: `isGroup: true`, a `groupName` and ≥ 2 other people. Rate limited (60 writes / 15 min).

BadRequest.description: Validation failed (message code 201) or a bad request.

Unauthorized.description: Missing, expired or revoked access token.

Forbidden.description: Not allowed (e.g. not an admin, private account, not your resource).

NotFound.description: Not found — also returned for blocked users and hidden content.

Conflict.description: Already exists (e.g. duplicate report or account).

ServiceUnavailable.description: Maintenance mode or the database/cache is unreachable.

refresh_token.description: JWT for `POST /auth/refresh` (single use; rotates both tokens).

isRestricted.description: Private account you do not follow: only the limited card is returned.
